drums.tags: Hard rock with heavy metal influences. Distorted electric guitars play palm-muted chugging riffs and power chords. A prominent bass guitar follows the guitar riffs with a thick, overdriven tone. The drum kit features a heavy snare, double-kick pedal patterns, and frequent crash cymbal accents. A high-pitched male vocal performs with a gritty, aggressive delivery and occasional melodic flourishes. The track is in the key of E minor at 140 BPM in 4/4 time. The arrangement features a breakdown with a syncopated guitar and drum pattern before returning to a driving tempo. Lead guitar sections include fast alternate picking and wah-pedal filtered solos.
drums.prompt:
[Intro]
[distorted electric guitar chugging riff, double-kick drums]
[bass guitar enters with heavy distortion]

[Verse 1]
[gritty male vocals]
I see the fire in your eyes [crash cymbal]
Burning through the lies we told
[palm-muted guitar rhythm]
Nothing left to sacrifice
As the world is turning cold

[Chorus]
[full band, driving tempo]
Break the chains and set it free (set it free)
[wah-pedal guitar lead]
Rising from the misery
[snare hits on every beat]
We are the ones who never fall
Standing tall against it all

[Bridge]
[half-time feel, syncopated guitar and kick drum]
No more running
No more hiding
[guitar solo with fast alternate picking]

[Outro]
[sustained power chord, feedback swell]
[final drum fill, cymbal crash]

bass.tags: Cinematic orchestral trailer music. Staccato string ostinatos in violins and violas drive the rhythmic momentum. Low brass, including trombones and tubas, perform sustained, dissonant swells and accented stabs. Taiko drums and large orchestral percussion provide heavy, syncopated accents on the downbeats. A high-pitched, metallic synth ping repeats at regular intervals. The arrangement features a gradual crescendo with layering of horns and aggressive cello rhythmic patterns. Key of D minor. Tempo is 140 BPM. 4/4 time signature. Short, dry string articulations contrast with long, reverberant brass tails. Sub-bass pulses sync with the orchestral percussion hits. High-frequency woodwind trills appear briefly during the build-up. The track concludes with a sudden silence followed by a final, resonant low-frequency impact.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[low sub-bass drone, metallic synth ping]
[staccato string ostinato enters]

[Build-up]
[taiko drum hits, syncopated orchestral percussion]

[high-pitched string tremolo]

[Climax]
[full orchestral ensemble, aggressive brass stabs]
[rapid-fire percussion rolls]
[heavy sub-bass impact]

[Outro]
[sudden silence]
[final resonant low-frequency hit]
